messages:
Maya Chen: FYI Acme POC is intermittently getting 403s from /v1/generate — they can get a few successful calls then boom 403. Customer key: demo_acme_key.
Liam Ortiz: Can you paste the exact response body + the request headers you saw?
Maya Chen: curl we ran:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer demo_acme_key' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-redwood-org: org-1234' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "Forbidden", "message": "org_id mismatch", "code": 403, "details": "request org: org-1234 token org: org-5678" }
```
Maya Chen: We also saw earlier a 401 from the auth service for different requests, then some 429s with Retry-After. Logs attached (request id r-0a1b2c3d).
Aria Patel: Sounds like token is bound to a different org/project or the key scope is wrong. Could the sales demo key be a scoped "embeddings-only" key accidentally used for generation?
Maya Chen: Good call — the key came from a pre-created demo bundle. I didn't check scopes.
Jules (Support): Quick check: you can call the Admin key introspect endpoint: `GET /v1/keys/demo_acme_key` (console or API) to see org_id & scopes. If you paste the result I can confirm.
Maya Chen: Introspect response (sanitized): `{ "key":"demo_acme_key","org_id":"org-5678","scopes":["embeddings.read"],"type":"api_key" }`
Liam Ortiz: There — token is for org-5678 and only embeddings.read. Your request had x-redwood-org: org-1234 and required `generate` scope.
Maya Chen: Ah. Customer says they didn't set an org header. Our SDK inserts customer's tenant header for them in some flows; but the demo harness might be forcing org-1234.
Sam Nguyen: infra-bot: Noted. There's also a recent policy change that started enforcing org header stricter on generate endpoints (deployed 2026-03-18). If using an org-scoped key mismatch you'll 403.
Aria Patel: Workarounds: 1) Use an account-scoped key that matches the customer org. 2) Create a new key under org-1234 with `api:generate` scope. 3) For quick unblock add correct `x-redwood-org` header matching key's org (only if that aligns with security checklist).
Maya Chen: I created a new key in the customer's demo org with `api:generate` scope and tested -> initial success. But after ~30s they started seeing 429s: `{ "error":"TooManyRequests","retry_after":12 }`
Liam Ortiz: That suggests they hit per-key rate limits on the hosted tier. Are they sending lots of parallel requests from their harness?
Maya Chen: They have a preload script spinning up 40 parallel conversations.
Jules (Support): Two paths: 1) Temporary bump to rate limit for the POC (we can do short uplift) — need account id + request ID. 2) Recommend enabling client-side concurrency limit and exponential backoff for the POC.
Aria Patel: Also check if they're using streaming incorrectly — opening connections and not draining can exhaust concurrency.
Maya Chen: Request id r-0a1b2c3d (same). Account: acme-enterprises-998. Can we do an uplift for the next 24 hours?
Jules (Support): Please fill this quick form: https://console.redwood.ai/support/poc-uplift with account id + requested QPS. I'll route to SRE.
Liam Ortiz: For pricing/commit question — if they need sustained higher throughput, Dedicated capacity slots start at ~$Xk/month per slot (ballpark). I'll DM you a formal quote link.
Sam Nguyen: infra-bot: Notifying SRE for temporary rate limit uplift for acme-enterprises-998.
Maya Chen: Uplift approved for 24h, SRE set QPS +20% at 2193456798, confirmed by infra-bot. POC runs green for ~90% of tests. :thumbsup:
Aria Patel: Couple follow-ups for security questionnaire: do they require key rotation frequency, KMS-backed keys, and audit logs? We should document that hosted keys are rotateable in Console, or private deployments can use customer-managed KMS.
Maya Chen: Customer asked about automatic key rotation and whether we can rotate without downtime.
Jules (Support): Hosted: rotation can be orchestrated with key aliasing and short TTLs; we have a runbook. Private: integrate with KMS/HSM — rotations handled by customer. I'll attach the runbook after the thread.
Maya Chen: Confirmed POC passed after uplift and new key. Customer requesting the runbook + formal uplift invoice. Thanks all.
Liam Ortiz: I'll follow up with pricing + draft uplift invoice.
Jules (Support): I'll upload runbook & put security questionnaire answers in the deal folder.
Maya Chen: Great — closing the immediate swarm. Will re-open if anything else pops up. :wave:
